content:
kevin: Received invoice HD-1122 from HelixData with no PO and the bank account is different from vendor record. PDF: https://redwood-drive/finance/invoices/HD-1122.pdf

ap-bot: Invoice imported (inv_20240610_1122). Flags: `missing_po`, `bank_account_mismatch`. Routed to tara_fin per vendor default routing.

tara_fin: I pulled the invoice. Total $9,240. Vendor listed payee as HelixData Ltd (vendor record is HelixData Inc). Can procurement confirm PO and entity? Also advise on GL coding if we hold.

procurement-bot: Searching POs for HelixData... Candidate PO 6677 matches HelixData Inc (committed $8,000). Invoice $9,240 != PO $8,000. Tagging @oscar_proc for follow-up.

oscar_proc: Taking this. Looks like $1,240 is labelled " expedited setup fee " on the invoice but not in SOW. Also payee mismatch: LTD vs INC. Ops or vendor contact needs to confirm whether expedited fee was authorized and whether legal entity changed. @vendor_ops can you confirm?

vendor_ops: We requested a one-off expedited migration but it was never approved in writing. Our AR accidentally invoiced the quoted estimate. We will ask AR to reissue invoice referencing PO 6677 for $8,000 or provide an approved change order for the $1,240. Also will correct payee if needed.

tara_fin: Placing AP hold: HOLD_INV_2034567890. Note: missing PO reference + bank/payee mismatch + $1,240 unapproved charge. Please do not remit. Adding comment: contact ar@helixdata.com.

oscar_proc: Procurement will request corrected invoice or credit memo within 48 hours. If vendor provides signed change order for expedited fee we can consider releasing full amount; otherwise remit only PO amount and hold variance. Also require W9 or entity change paperwork if payee differs.

kevin: Thank you. Added AP comment with suggested payment split logic: pay $8,000 (if validated) and hold $1,240 pending approved change order. If vendor tries to push payment, escalate to vendor manager.

ap-bot: AP record updated: status=HOLD_INV_2034567890, audit_id=AUD-HD-7781. Reminder set: escalate in 48 hours if no vendor response.

oscar_proc: I'll post an update after I hear back from AR. If they reissue quickly we can avoid dispute. :email:

kevin: Great, keep us posted.
